heard: From Pontus they came, Aquila and wife Leaving Rome behind, obeying life Claudia sent the Jews away To Corinth they traveled that day Paul found a trade they all could share Ten making work was in the air He stayed with them, they worked as one, a fellowship under the sun. Priscilla and Aquila, guiding us to see the way of God is clear in their home for free. Thank you.
